help.turn: Turns the camera on or off (alias for `sleep` and `wake`)
help.tracking: Controls the AI-tracking-mode of the camera
help.speed: Controls the tracking speed of the camera
help.preset: Sets the camera to a specific preset position previously defined in OBSBOT Center
help.hdr: Controls the HDR-mode of the camera
help.exposure: Controls the exposure-mode of the camera
help.info: Displays information about the current state of the camera
help.version: Displays the version of the CLI-tool
help.completions: Generates shell-completion scripts for the CLI-tool

args.lang: Setting the language for the current command execution
args.auto_sleep_time: off, 30s, 2m, 10m or a time in seconds

help.auto_sleep: Sets the time after which the camera falls asleep on its own
help.sleep_background: Sets what the camera shows while asleep
help.led: Sets the brightness of the status LED (off, 1, 2, 3)
help.fov: Sets the field of view of the camera
help.mirror: Mirrors the image of the camera
help.invert: Reverses the gimbal's left/right direction; the image does not change (the camera does not report this setting)

audio.command: Controls the microphone of the camera
audio.noise_reduction: Sets the noise reduction of the microphone
audio.auto_gain: Turns the automatic gain of the microphone on or off
audio.mic_in_sleep: Keeps the microphone on while the camera is asleep
audio.mic: Enables or disables the microphone (the camera restarts)

gesture.command: Controls the gesture control of the camera (only target lock is reported back by the camera)
gesture.target_lock: Turns the target lock gesture on or off
gesture.zoom: Turns the zoom gesture on or off
gesture.dynamic_zoom: Turns the dynamic zoom gesture on or off
gesture.direction: Turns the mirrored direction of the gestures on or off
gesture.zoom_ratio: Sets how far the zoom gesture zooms in (1.0 to 4.0)

help.factory_reset: Resets the camera to its factory settings (the camera restarts)

audio.warning_restart: Warning: the camera may restart to apply this setting and be unavailable for about 20 seconds.

factory_reset.warning: This resets all settings of the camera to their factory defaults. The camera restarts afterwards.
factory_reset.request_confirmation: Reset the camera to its factory settings?
factory_reset.response: Resetting the camera to its factory settings
